program_name: Slovenian Film Centre (SFC) Cash Rebate and Production Support

notes: This is a formal 25% QPE cash rebate.

program_name: Ukrainian State Film Agency Production Support
stacking_notes: 25% base + 5% cultural bonus. Practically suspended due to martial law.
notes: Legally on the books as a 25-30% QPE cash rebate, but currently suspended/inoperable due to the war.

program_name: Russian Cinema Fund (Fond Kino) Production Support
stacking_notes: Federal rebate 30-40% technically exists but is inaccessible to Western/international shoots.
notes: Legally on the books, but practically suspended/inoperable for international/Western shoots due to sanctions and war.

stacking_notes: Direct subsidies and co-production support (primarily with Russia). No QPE rebate.
notes: No active cash rebate for foreign shoots.

stacking_notes: 25% base + 5% cultural bonus. Requires local co-producer.

stacking_notes: ICAIC controls all state production and support. No cash rebate.

notes: No formal cash rebate for foreign shoots.

stacking_notes: Base 25% goods/20% labor. GOLR adds 6.2%. rOPIF offers regional support. L-OPIF for local micro-budgets.
notes: Secondary programs include Greenlight (GOLR), rOPIF, and L-OPIF.

program_name: Washington State Motion Picture Competitiveness Program
stacking_notes: Base 30%. Secondary programs include SBPI (Small Budget). Uplifts include 10% Rural, 10% Underrepresented.
notes: Includes SBPI and FWD workforce initiatives.

stacking_notes: Base 35% tax credit. Uplifts: 15% Economically Disadvantaged Area (EDA), 5% outside Chicago, 5% Relocation, 5% Green.
notes: Massive stackable uplifts up to 55%.

stacking_notes: Base 25% grant. Features Micro-Budget grant fund for smaller budgets.
notes: Includes secondary Micro-Budget grant.

stacking_notes: Base 20-25% wages. 30% supplier rebate. Stackable 5% in-state supplier uplift.
notes: Includes Investor Tax Credits as well.

stacking_notes: Flat 25% transferable/refundable tax credit. No regional or demographic uplifts.
notes: Flat 25% with 90% direct cash-out option.

program_name: Texas Moving Image Industry Incentive Program (MIIP)
stacking_notes: Base grant 5-25% depending on spend. Highly stackable uplifts for rural, veterans, post-production.
notes: Total effective grant can reach 31%.

stacking_notes: Base 10-30% depending on spend (30% for over $1M). Transferable.
notes: Simple tiered structure. Future urban uplifts approved.

stacking_notes: Base 25% tax credit. +5% for utilizing a Qualified Production Facility (QPF).
notes: Includes a $5M reserve fund for independent PA filmmakers.

program_name: Maryland Film Production Activity Tax Credit
stacking_notes: Base 28% refundable tax credit. 2% uplift for TV series. Has a "Maryland Small Films" carve-out.
notes: Features specific secondary provisions for small/indie films.

program_name: Virginia Motion Picture Production Tax Credit
stacking_notes: Base 15%. Highly stackable uplifts for distressed areas, VA resident payroll, and first-time employees.
uplift_type: Distressed Area (5%), VA Resident (10-20%), First-Time Emp (10%)
notes: Uplifts apply specific stackable percentages to particular wage or spend pools.

authority: Colorado Office of Film, Television and Media
stacking_notes: 2024 update: Converted from cash rebate to refundable tax credit. Base 20%. +2% for rural/marginalized urban.
notes: HB 24-1358 restructured the program.

program_name: Tennessee Film, Entertainment & Music Commission Incentives
stacking_notes: Base 25% discretionary cash grant. Scorecard system can boost to 30%.
notes: Discretionary grant, not a guaranteed tax credit. Includes Music Scoring Grant.

stacking_notes: Base 20% cash rebate. Highly stackable uplifts up to 38% (Rural, TV, Post, Music, Soundstage).
uplift_type: Rural (3%), Soundstage (5%), TV (2-5%), Multi-Film (5%), Post (3%), Music (2%)
notes: Stand-Alone Post-Production Incentive (SAPI) also exists.

stacking_notes: 25% on expenditures, 35% on resident payroll. Small budget provision offers 45% on payroll.
notes: Includes dedicated music funding. Capped annually.

stacking_notes: Base 30% refundable tax credit. 35% if shooting in enhanced county or using resident labor.
notes: Cannot exceed 35% total.

program_name: Alberta Film and Television Tax Credit (FTTC)
stacking_notes: Base 22% for foreign-owned, 30% for AB-owned. Foreign-owned can unlock 30% via rural/remote filming uplift.
notes: Uplift specifically closes the gap for foreign productions.

program_name: Manitoba Film & Video Production Tax Credit | Manitoba Film & Music — Production Support Grants
stacking_notes: Cost of Salaries (up to 65%) or Cost of Production (up to 38%). Very aggressive uplifts.
uplift_type: Frequent Filming (10%), Rural (5%), MB Producer (5%), MB Company (8%)
notes: Stacks with Canadian Federal incentive.

program_name: Nova Scotia Film & Television Production Incentive Fund
stacking_notes: Base 25-26% provincial incentive. Distant location (10%), rural (2%), NS content (3%) uplifts stack.
uplift_type: Distant Location (10%), Rural (2%), Duration (1%), NS Content (3%)
notes: Separate Screen Nova Scotia Content Creator Fund acts as an additional top-up.

stacking_notes: Administered via the LIFT program. Major stream offers 25-35% grant. Micro stream 30%.
uplift_type: Up to 10% in stackable LIFT bonuses
notes: LIFT is a grant-based system stacking on federal CPTC/PSTC.

stacking_notes: Regional top-up grant designed to stack with UK AVEC/IFTC national credits. Requires 10:1 Scottish spend.
notes: Cannot be combined with other specific Screen Scotland production funds.

program_name: Wales Screen Production Fund (Ffilm Cymru Wales)
stacking_notes: Discretionary regional production funding. Stacks with UK National AVEC.
notes: Focuses on skills legacy, sustainability, and regional economic impact.

stacking_notes: Typically 3-10% of Victorian spend. Stacks with Australian Federal Offsets (PDV/Producer/Location).
notes: RLAF requires $100k regional spend and 5 days filming.

program_name: Hawaii Film and Digital Media Income Tax Credit
stacking_notes: Base 22% on Oʻahu. Neighbor Islands get 5% uplift. Local Hire (80%+) gets 5% uplift.
notes: Recent legislation waived the per-project cap for productions spending over $60M.

stacking_notes: Base 20%. 5% uplift for rural shooting OR high local hire ratio.
notes: Micro-budgets can use the CFIP for a flat 20% rebate.

stacking_notes: State base is 25% transferable tax credit. Highly stackable with independent local/county rebates.
uplift_type: Various Local/County Rebates (e.g. St. Louis County 25%)
notes: State does not offer intrinsic uplifts, but allows aggressive regional stacking.

stacking_notes: Base 25% cash rebate. Uplifts for residents and veterans.
notes: New Episodic TV incentive added offering up to 40%.

stacking_notes: Base tier (15-20%) depends on total spend. Three 2.5% uplifts available.
notes: Max theoretical ceiling is 27.5%.

program_name: Puerto Rico Film Industry Economic Incentives Act
stacking_notes: Act 60 provides 40% base on resident spend. Extremely aggressive uplifts.
notes: Credits are highly transferable. Co-production incentive operates as a direct percentage uplift.

program_name: Creative Saskatchewan Film and TV Production Grant
stacking_notes: FFTV grant base is 25%. Stackable bonuses can push rate higher.
uplift_type: Rural (5%), SK Post (5%), SK Volume Bonus (10%)
notes: Functions structurally as a grant rather than an automatic tax return, though evaluated similarly.

program_name: Newfoundland & Labrador Film Development Corp Production Incentive
stacking_notes: 40% All-Spend or 40% Labour-based tax credit. Rebranded to PictureNL.
notes: Exceptionally high 40% base offsets the lack of modular uplifts seen in other provinces.

stacking_notes: 25% Base. Highly modular stackable uplifts for local content, rural, and VFX.
uplift_type: Resident Labor (15%), LA Screenplay (10%), Outside NOLA (5%), VFX (5%)
notes: Maximum overall credit limit is generally 40%. Requires workforce development participation.

program_name: New Mexico Film Production Tax Credit
stacking_notes: 25% base. 10% rural uplift zone, 5% TV/Facility uplift.
notes: TV and QPF uplifts cannot be stacked together. Max effective is 40%.

stacking_notes: Base 15% transferable tax credit. Capped at $10M annually. Stacks with two 5% uplifts.
uplift_type: BTL Resident Bonus (5%), Rural Location Bonus (5%)
notes: Max theoretical credit is 25%. Annual cap heavily restricts access.

program_name: Rhode Island Motion Picture Production Tax Credit
stacking_notes: Flat 30% transferable tax credit. No modular uplifts.
notes: Must shoot 51% in RI or spend 51% budget in RI, or have a high-spend waiver.

stacking_notes: Regional soft-loan/grant evaluating the NRW-Effekt (local spend ratio).
notes: Designed to stack with the national German Federal Film Fund (DFFF).

program_name: Film i Väst — Regional Co-production Fund
stacking_notes: Operates as an equity co-producer/fund rather than a tax rebate. Requires 100% regional spend of investment.
notes: Stacks with national Tillväxtverket 25% cash rebate.

stacking_notes: Discretionary recoupable loan/grant. Caps generally around £800k - £1M depending on project.
notes: Directly stacks with UK AVEC.

stacking_notes: Regional soft-loan/grant. Added FOKUS program in 2024 for high regional impact.
notes: Requires 100% regional spend of awarded funds. Stacks with national DFFF.

stacking_notes: Regional grant. Evaluated on a competitive points basis (local shooting days, crew).
notes: Stacks with the Italian National Tax Credit (40%).

program_name: Film Commission Torino Piemonte — Production Support
stacking_notes: Piemonte Film TV Fund provides non-repayable grants. Evaluated competitively.
notes: Stacks with the Italian National Tax Credit (40%).

program_name: Basque Audiovisual — Eusko Jaurlaritza Film Production Support
stacking_notes: Bizkaia Foral tax system offers 35-60% based on local spend tiers, plus a 10% language uplift.
uplift_type: Basque Language Uplift (10%), High Local Spend Uplift (Up to +25%)
notes: Distinct from the general Spanish national incentive due to Basque fiscal sovereignty.

stacking_notes: Offers discretionary Production Attraction Incentive (~10%) and 20% WA PDV (Post/VFX) incentive.
notes: Stacks perfectly with Australian National Offsets (Location Offset 30%, PDV Offset 30%).

program_name: South Australian Film Corporation (SAFC) — Production Incentive
stacking_notes: Offers 10% SA PDV Rebate and a discretionary Screen Production Fund.
notes: Stacks perfectly with Australian National Offsets (Location Offset 30%, PDV Offset 30%).

stacking_notes: Discretionary regional grant/soft-loan based on regional economic effect.
notes: Requires significant regional spend. Stacks with the national DFFF (20-25%).
